t.en: “It is the weekend” means: today is Saturday, or today is Sunday. At least one holds, and both count too: the gate of .

<level-ref to="decl-or"></level-ref> declared “or”, and with it came <part-ref to="part:orI"></part-ref>: from a sentence, “it ∨ any other” holds. Choosing on the part whether it goes left or right chooses one of the two introduction rules; the other side is chosen on the part too.

hint.en: Build it from the inside out.
First bring in “today is Saturday ∨ today is Sunday” (the other side on the right), then put that on the right of another ∨.
